The bridge passes chosen data points bet: The bridge passes chosen data points between ioBroker installations at different sites (e.g. over VPN). Every site keeps running on its own. A site that offers data points enters them under 'Share'; a site that wants to see them enters the other site under 'Sites'. Both use the same key.
Shown at the other sites, e.g. Friseursa: Shown at the other sites, e.g. Friseursalon
Data points this site offers. Only these: Data points this site offers. Only these can be seen by the other sites, and only those with 'may switch' can be switched from there. A whole area: enter the folder with .* at the end, e.g. spc-edp.0.areas.*
The other sites connect to this port (al: The other sites connect to this port (allow it in the firewall / VPN)
At least 8 characters; the other sites e: At least 8 characters; the other sites enter the same key. It never goes over the network, the data is encrypted with it.
Empty = all network cards; e.g. the VPN: Empty = all network cards; e.g. the VPN address so the bridge is not reachable from the LAN
Other sites whose shared data points sho: Other sites whose shared data points should appear here (under bruecke.0.<site>.…). Address = VPN address of the ioBroker there, optional with :port (default 8102). Key = the access key set there.
Name: Name
